residue.statement: No native clean Windows x86-64 runner has compiled or tested the candidate with the MSVC toolchain.
Process-token SID derivation has not been observed across native Windows application relaunches.
SQLite durability, locking, crash recovery, migration, backup, and restore have not been exercised on Windows filesystems.
MSI and NSIS bundles have not been produced, inspected, installed, upgraded, downgraded, uninstalled, or cleanly relaunched on Windows.
WebView2 bootstrapper installation, CSP behavior, startup, lifecycle, and failure modes have not been exercised on Windows.
Keyboard, screen-reader, scaling, contrast, focus, and platform accessibility behavior have not been assessed on Windows.
The framed JSON codec is portable, but the Unix listener is excluded and no Windows named-pipe listener or peer-token binding is implemented.
Code signing, release publication, distribution, and deployment are outside this candidate and remain unauthorized.
OPT-PLATFORM-LINUX-X64-FIRST remains selected; Windows remains deferred and this adapter does not alter that decision.
No independent Windows implementation-binding or conformance review has accepted this candidate.
